title: IT and Systems Administrator (Cloud Hosting Mandatory)
description:
IT and Systems Administrator

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-6 years

Work Locations: On-site across our Factory, Warehouse and Head Office

About the Role

We are looking for an IT and Systems Administrator to manage our complete technology infrastructure, hardware, cloud hosting and critical business applications. This role goes beyond routine IT support. You will own our technical operations and keep our local networks, Wi-Fi and cloud platforms (AWS) reliable, with maximum uptime for our ERP and Tally servers. Our operations are spread across locations, so you will work across our Factory, Warehouse and Head Office to keep the business running as the organisation grows.

What You'll Do

* Manage internal hardware, including provisioning, configuration and maintenance of PCs, laptops and VoIP phone systems

* Maintain an accurate hardware and software inventory, covering asset management, licensing compliance and lifecycle tracking

* Own network administration, including LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches and enterprise firewalls, for security and seamless connectivity

* Administer our Google Workspace (G Suite) environment, including user accounts, access management and security settings

* Create, implement and enforce IT policies, best practices and internal security controls

* Deal directly with IT vendors, service providers and ISPs on procurement, contract negotiation and issue resolution

* Manage, update and troubleshoot Windows, macOS and Linux systems across the organisation

* Oversee hosting, deployment and optimisation of our website and central ERP system on AWS or similar cloud infrastructure

* Manage on-premise or cloud-based Tally servers so finance and accounting run smoothly

* Monitor the uptime, health and performance of the ERP system to keep it highly available

* Manage endpoint security, VPNs, user access and credentials to protect company data

* Design, implement and maintain regular data backups and disaster recovery protocols for on-premise and cloud environments

* Work with teams across all locations to resolve support queries, onboarding issues and access problems quickly

What We're Looking For

* 4-6 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud management or a related field

* Readiness to work on-site across the Factory, Warehouse and Head Office as required

* Expert-level knowledge of cloud hosting, specifically AWS (EC2, RDS and similar) or equivalent platforms

* Strong practical knowledge of network configuration, Wi-Fi management, LAN setups and enterprise firewall administration

* Experience in ERP technical administration, Tally server maintenance and proactive uptime management

* Proven experience in G Suite administration, hardware and software inventory management and IT policy formulation

* Strong negotiation and communication skills, with a record of dealing effectively with IT vendors

* Practical experience managing mixed-OS environments (Windows, macOS, Linux) and daily hardware troubleshooting.

Pay: Up to ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Desktop Support Engineer Intern
description:
**Position Title**: Desktop Support Engineer Intern Department:

**About the Role:** We are seeking a motivated, tech-savvy Desktop Support Engineer Intern to join our IT infrastructure team.

This is a hands-on internship designed for an enthusiastic individual looking to gain deep, practical experience in enterprise IT support, hardware deployment, basic networking, and Active Directory administration. You will work alongside experienced IT professionals to ensure seamless daily operations for our end-users and office infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Hardware & Peripheral Management

● Deployment & Setup: Install, configure, and deploy new desktop computers, laptops, monitors, printers, and other IT peripherals.

● Troubleshooting & Maintenance: Diagnose and resolve hardware failures, perform component upgrades (RAM, SSD/HDD, power supplies), and manage regular preventive maintenance schedules.

● Asset Tracking: Maintain accurate inventory records of all hardware assets, hardware lifecycle status, and peripheral deployments. 2. Network Administration & Connectivity

● LAN/WAN Support: Troubleshoot and maintain Local Area Networks (LAN), office switches, access points, and routers to ensure stable internet and network connectivity.

● Client Troubleshooting: Diagnose wired and wireless connectivity issues, IP configuration errors, and network printer accessibility problems for end-users. 3. Active Directory (AD) & User Management

● User Lifecycle Management: Create, update, and manage user accounts, security groups, and organizational units (OUs) within Active Directory.

● Group Policy Management: Assist in applying, troubleshooting, and testing basic Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to enforce security baselines, software deployment, and desktop restrictions.

● Access Control: Handle password resets, permission requests, and role-based access provisioning. 4. End-User Technical Support (Helpdesk)

● Provide first- and second-level technical support for Windows operating systems, business productivity software, and standard office applications.

● Diagnose and resolve software conflicts, driver issues, and email/client configuration problems. Qualifications & Requirements

● Education: Currently pursuing or a recent graduate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related technical field

● Technical Knowledge: ○ Solid understanding of PC hardware components, assembly, and diagnostic tools. ○ Fundamental knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, switches, routers, and Wi-Fi access points). ○ Familiarity with Active Directory administration (managing user accounts, resetting passwords, and basic Group Policy configuration). ○ Working knowledge of Windows OS installation, configuration, and troubleshooting

● Soft Skills: ○ Strong troubleshooting and analytical mindset. ○ Good communication and interpersonal skills to assist non-technical end-users professionally. ○ Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced enterprise IT environment. What You Will Learn

● Real-world enterprise IT infrastructure management across dual offices/networks

● Hands-on experience with load balancers, domain controllers, and advanced peripheral setups

● Practical exposure to corporate IT security policies and directory services.

Pay: From ₹7,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Desktop Support Engineer
description:
We are looking for a reliable, technical, and candidate-focused **Desktop Support Engineer** to join our IT support team. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving hardware, software, and network issues, installing and configuring systems, and delivering end-user technical support across our organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **System Setup & Maintenance:** Install, configure, and maintain desktop hardware, laptops, operating systems (Windows/macOS), and software applications.
* **Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve hardware errors, OS failures, peripheral issues (printers, scanners, monitors), and network connectivity problems.
* **User Support:** Provide prompt and effective technical support to internal employees both on-site and remotely via ticketing systems/helpdesk tools.
* **Account & Access Management:** Create, manage, and reset user accounts, passwords, and access permissions in Active Directory and office tools (e.g., Office 365, Google Workspace).
* **Network & Peripheral Support:** Assist with basic network configuration (LAN/Wi-Fi troubleshooting, IP assignment) and manage IT hardware inventory.
* **Documentation & Asset Management:** Maintain accurate logs of IT hardware/software assets and document common technical troubleshooting solutions.

**Requirements & Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years of hands-on experience in Desktop Support, Helpdesk Support, or IT Technical Support.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 operating systems (macOS knowledge is a plus).
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Routers/Switches).
* Familiarity with Active Directory, Office 365 / Google Workspace administration.
* Experience handling peripheral devices, printers, and desktop/laptop hardware components.
* **Soft Skills:** Good communication, problem-solving mindset, and a customer-first approach.

**Preferred Certifications (Optional):**

* CompTIA A+ / Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator

**Job Details & Benefits:**

* **Job Type:** Full-time
* **Work Location:** On-site / Hybrid *(Customize as applicable)*
* **Benefits:** Competitive salary, health insurance, paid time off, and technical growth opportunities.

* Windows 10 / Windows 11

* Google Workspace
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* VPN Troubleshooting
* Hardware Troubleshooting

**Certifications & Qualifications**

* CompTIA A+
* CompTIA Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator
